mapper.sql: flt10_tr_id AS tr_id, flt10_company_id AS company_id, flt10_person_id AS person_id, flt10_tr_type AS tr_type, f_cdnm('FloorTrCode', flt10_tr_type, flt10_company_id, f_today()) AS tr_type_name, flt10_account_id AS account_id, flt10_account_info AS account_info, flt10_account_relate_cd AS account_relate_code, TO_CHAR(flt10_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, flt10_item_type AS item_type, flt10_item_type_nm AS item_type_name, flt10_item_nm AS item_name, flt10_item_cd AS item_code, flt10_expect_tr_qty AS expect_tr_qty, flt10_expect_tr_amt AS expect_tr_amt, TO_CHAR(flt10_expect_tr_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expect_tr_date, flt10_check_buy_lockup AS check_buy_lockup, CASE WHEN f_get_floorTrFundHoldCheck( flt10_company_id , flt10_item_cd , LEAST(flt10_reg_date, f_get_biz_date2(flt10_company_id, f_today(), '-1', 'true')) ) THEN '펀드종목' ELSE '' END AS check_fund_hold, flt10_tr_reason AS tr_reason, flt10_status_cd AS status_code, f_cdnm('FloorTrStatusCode', flt10_status_cd, flt10_company_id, f_today()) AS status_name, flt10_reject_reason AS reject_reason, TO_CHAR(flt10_tr_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_date, COALESCE(flt10_unfill_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS unfill_yn, flt10_stk_price_yn = 'true' AS stk_price_yn, flt10_check_target_yn = 'true' AS check_target_yn, flt10_book_qty AS book_qty, flt10_book_amt AS book_amt, CASE WHEN rcnt_buy_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE f_get_biz_days(flt10_company_id, rcnt_buy_date, flt10_reg_date)-1||'영업일' END AS book_days

SELECT flt10_tr.* , flt05.flt05_item_type_nm AS flt10_item_type_nm , COALESCE(COALESCE(flt05_tr.flt05_stk_price_yn, flt05.flt05_stk_price_yn)::varchar, 'false') AS flt10_stk_price_yn , COALESCE(COALESCE(flt05_tr.flt05_target_yn , flt05.flt05_target_yn )::varchar, 'false') AS flt10_check_target_yn , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ') ' || flt03_account_nm AS flt10_account_info , f_cdnm('BuyLockupType', flt08_lockup_type, flt10_company_id, f_today()) AS flt10_check_buy_lockup , flt03_family_relate_cd AS flt10_account_relate_cd , COALESCE(flt11_book_amt,0) AS flt10_book_amt , COALESCE(flt11_book_qty,0) AS flt10_book_qty , f_get_floorTrRcntBuyDate( flt10_company_id, flt10_person_id, flt10_account_id , flt10_item_type, flt10_item_nm, flt10_item_cd , flt10_reg_date, true ) AS rcnt_buy_date FROM flt10_tr INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05 ON ( flt05.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_expect_tr_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05_tr ON ( flt05_tr.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_tr.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_tr.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_tr_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt11_book ON ( flt11_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt11_person_id = flt10_person_id AND flt11_account_id = flt10_account_id AND flt11_item_type = flt10_item_type AND ( ( COALESCE(flt05.flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') = 'true' AND flt11_item_cd = flt10_item_cd ) OR ( COALESCE(flt05.flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') != 'true' AND flt11_item_nm = flt10_item_nm ) ) AND flt11_book_date = f_get_biz_date(flt10_company_id,flt10_reg_date,'-1') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt08_buy_lockup ON ( flt08_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt08_item_cd = flt10_item_cd AND flt10_reg_date BETWEEN flt08_start_date AND COALESCE(flt08_close_date,'9999-12-31') )

SELECT TRUE AS has_emp, flt02_check_cycle AS check_cycle, flt02_year_invest_limit AS year_invest_limit, COALESCE(flt01_invest_amt_calc_target_cd,'1') AS invest_amt_calc_target_code, COALESCE(flt01_invest_amt_over_check_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS invest_amt_over_check_yn, NULL AS oath_status_code, NULL AS today, NULL AS flt_only_curr_yn FROM flt02_emp INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = flt02_person_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND flt01_rpt_start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) flt01 ON TRUE WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT TO_CHAR(f_today(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.sql: SELECT * , flt10_reg_date AS chk_date , true AS expect_yn FROM flt10_tr chk INNER JOIN flt03_account ON ( flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id AND flt03_family_relate_cd = '1' ) INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_target_yn = 'true' AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_expect_tr_date ) ) WHERE chk.flt10_person_id = #{personId} AND chk.flt10_reg_date BETWEEN date_trunc('month', CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND chk.flt10_tr_type = '10I' /*(10I:매수)*/ AND COALESCE(chk.flt10_status_cd,'00') != '30' /*(30:반려)제외*/ AND COALESCE(chk.flt10_unfill_yn, 'false') != 'true' /*미체결 사전신고거래 제외*/ AND chk.flt10_tr_date IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT * , flt10_tr_date AS chk_date , false AS expect_yn FROM flt10_tr chk INNER JOIN flt03_account ON ( flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id AND flt03_family_relate_cd = '1' ) INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_target_yn = 'true' AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_tr_date ) ) WHERE chk.flt10_person_id = #{personId} AND chk.flt10_tr_date BETWEEN date_trunc('month', CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND chk.flt10_tr_type = '10I' /*(10I:매수)*/ AND COALESCE(chk.flt10_unfill_yn, 'false') != 'true' /*미체결 사전신고거래 제외*/ AND chk.flt10_tr_date IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT flt10_tr_id AS tr_id, flt10_check_type_nm AS check_type_name, flt10_year_invest_limit AS year_invest_limit, flt10_total_invest_amt AS total_invest_amt, flt10_turnover_rate AS turnover_rate, flt10_month_buy_count AS month_buy_count, flt10_day_buy_count AS day_buy_count FROM ( SELECT 1 AS flt10_tr_id , '투자한도' AS flt10_check_type_nm , flt02_year_invest_limit AS flt10_year_invest_limit /* 연간 투자금액 */ , flt01_total_invest_amt AS flt10_total_invest_amt /* 총누적 투자금액 */ , flt01_turnover_rate AS flt10_turnover_rate /* 월간 매매회전율 */ , 30 AS flt10_month_buy_count /* 월간 매수주문횟수*/ , 3 AS flt10_day_buy_count /* 일간 매수주문횟수*/ FROM ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) a , ( SELECT * FROM flt02_emp WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) b UNION ALL SELECT 2 , '현재 투자금액 (사전신고 포함)' , f_get_floorTrCheck('1', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), true) , f_get_floorTrCheck('2', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), true) , f_get_floorTrCheck('3', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), true) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) t) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) t WHERE chk_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) UNION ALL SELECT 3 , '현재 투자금액 (사전신고 제외)' , f_get_floorTrCheck('1', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false) , f_get_floorTrCheck('2', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false) , f_get_floorTrCheck('3', #{companyId}, #{personId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) t WHERE expect_yn = false) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) t WHERE chk_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND expect_yn = false) ) a ORDER BY flt10_tr_id

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY item_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS tr_id , item_nm AS item_name , flt05_item_type_nm AS item_type_name FROM ( SELECT flt10_item_nm item_nm , flt10_item_type item_type FROM flt10_tr WHERE flt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt10_person_id = #{personId} UNION SELECT flt10_tr_item_nm item_nm , flt10_tr_item_type item_type FROM flt10_tr WHERE flt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt10_person_id = #{personId} UNION SELECT flt13_item_nm item_nm , flt13_item_type item_type FROM flt13_book_init WHERE flt13_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt13_person_id = #{personId} ) t INNER JOIN flt05_item_type a ON ( flt05_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt05_item_type_cd = item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt05_item_type_cd = item_type AND flt05_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) ) WHERE item_nm ILIKE #{searchText} AND COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn,'false') != 'true' GROUP BY item_nm, flt05_item_type_nm

SELECT TO_CHAR(f_get_biz_date(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), '+' || (flt01_appr_valid_days - 1)::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(flt01_fund_hold_stk_yn, 'false') = 'true' FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN chk1.cnt != 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END || CASE WHEN chk2.cnt != 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END || CASE WHEN chk3.cnt != 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END FROM ( /*--- chk1:매수제한종목 ---*/ SELECT count(*) cnt FROM flt08_buy_lockup WHERE flt08_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt08_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) BETWEEN flt08_start_date AND COALESCE(flt08_close_date,'9999-12-31') ) chk1 , ( /*--- chk2 : 펀드/일임(자문)보유종목 ---*/ SELECT count(*) cnt FROM ( SELECT fnd10_book_id FROM fnd10_book WHERE fnd10_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd10_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND fnd10_std_date = LEAST(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), f_get_biz_date2(fnd10_company_id, f_today(), '-1', 'true')) AND fnd10_item_group_cd = '3' /*(3:주식)*/ AND fnd10_market_cd != 'B' /*(B:비상장)*/ UNION ALL SELECT fnd11_book_extr_id FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND fnd11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd11_std_date) FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_std_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) AND fnd11_item_type = '2010' /*(2010:주식)*/ UNION ALL SELECT flt09_fund_item_id FROM flt09_fund_item WHERE flt09_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt09_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND flt09_std_date = LEAST(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), f_get_biz_date2(flt09_company_id, f_today(), '-1', 'true')) AND flt09_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) UNION ALL SELECT adv10_book_id FROM adv10_book WHERE adv10_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv10_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND adv10_std_date = LEAST(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), f_get_biz_date2(adv10_company_id, f_today(), '-1', 'true')) UNION ALL SELECT adv11_book_extr_id FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND adv11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(adv11_std_date) FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_std_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) AND adv11_item_type = '2010' /*(2010:주식)*/ ) t ) chk2 , ( /*--- chk3:고유자산 ---*/ SELECT count(*) cnt FROM ast09_book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN com50_item ON com50_item_short_cd = ast01_isin AND com50_item_type = '2010' WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_qty != 0 AND com50_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND ast01_asset_type = '1' /*(1:고유자산)*/ AND ast01_item_s_class_cd IN ('201010','201011') /*(201010:상장주식/201011:IPO)*/ AND (ast09_ast_class_tree_id ,ast09_keep_account_id ,ast09_hold_date ) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id , ast09_keep_account_id , MAX(ast09_hold_date) FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) ) chk3
SELECT f_create_seq()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt10_tr (flt10_tr_id, flt10_company_id, flt10_person_id, flt10_tr_type, flt10_account_id, flt10_reg_date, flt10_expect_tr_date, flt10_appr_yn, flt10_item_type, flt10_item_nm, flt10_item_cd, flt10_expect_tr_qty, flt10_expect_tr_amt, flt10_tr_reason) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.trType}, #{req.accountId}, CAST(#{req.regDate} AS date), CAST(#{req.expectTrDate} AS date), 'false', #{req.itemType}, #{req.itemName}, #{req.itemCode}, #{req.expectTrQty}, #{req.expectTrAmt}, #{req.trReason})
mapper.select: SELECT flt03_account_id AS account_id, flt03_main_account_yn = 'true' AS main_account_yn, CASE WHEN flt03_main_account_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END AS main_account_yn_str, flt03_family_relate_cd AS family_relate_code, f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS family_relate_name, sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt06_close_date,'9999-12-31') < CAST(#{setupDate} AS date) THEN '(폐쇄) ' ELSE '' END || TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS account_no_dec, flt03_account_nm AS account_name, f_get_itemtype_nm(flt03_item_type, flt03_company_id) AS item_type_name, TO_CHAR(flt03_setup_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setup_date FROM flt03_account LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN flt06_account_close ON flt06_account_id = flt03_account_id WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_person_id = #{personId} AND flt03_setup_date <= CAST(#{setupDate} AS date) AND COALESCE(flt06_close_date,'9999-12-31') >= CAST(#{setupDate} AS date) ORDER BY CASE WHEN flt03_main_account_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , sys15_corp_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no)

SELECT flt05_item_type_id AS code_id , flt05_item_type_cd AS code , flt05_item_type_nm AS name , COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn::varchar, 'false') = 'true' AS stk_price_yn , COALESCE(flt05_target_yn::varchar, 'false') = 'true' AS target_yn FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = #{companyId} AND (flt05_item_type_cd, flt05_start_date) IN ( SELECT flt05_item_type_cd, MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt05_start_date <= CAST(#{startDate} AS date) GROUP BY flt05_item_type_cd ) ORDER BY flt05_seq
mapper.sql: flt10_tr_id AS tr_id, flt10_account_id AS account_id, flt10_account_info AS account_info, flt10_account_no AS account_no, flt10_account_relate_nm AS account_relate_name, flt10_account_relate_cd AS account_relate_code, flt10_tr_type AS tr_type, flt10_tr_type_nm AS tr_type_name, flt10_status_nm AS status_name, CONCAT( over_amt_msg , CASE WHEN over_amt_msg IS NOT NULL AND over_qty_msg IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' ELSE '' END , over_qty_msg , CASE WHEN (over_amt_msg IS NOT NULL OR over_qty_msg IS NOT NULL) AND over_period_msg IS NOT NULL THEN ', ' ELSE '' END , over_period_msg ) AS check_period, TO_CHAR(flt10_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, flt10_item_type AS item_type, flt10_item_type_nm AS item_type_name, flt10_item_nm AS item_name, flt10_item_cd AS item_code, flt10_expect_tr_qty AS expect_tr_qty, flt10_expect_tr_amt AS expect_tr_amt, flt10_tr_reason AS tr_reason, TO_CHAR(flt10_tr_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_date, flt10_tr_item_type AS tr_item_type, flt10_tr_item_type_nm AS tr_item_type_name, flt10_tr_item_nm AS tr_item_name, flt10_tr_item_cd AS tr_item_code, flt10_tr_qty AS tr_qty, flt10_tr_amt AS tr_amt, flt10_tr_note AS tr_note, flt10_bef_tr_amt AS bef_tr_amt, flt10_stk_price_yn AS stk_price_yn, flt10_check_target_yn AS check_target_yn, flt10_appr_id AS appr_id, TO_CHAR(flt10_appr_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_reg_date, flt10_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code, flt10_appr_status_nm AS appr_status_name

SELECT flt10_tr.* , f_cdnm('FloorTrCode', flt10_tr_type, flt10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS flt10_tr_type_nm , flt05.flt05_item_type_nm AS flt10_item_type_nm , flt05_tr.flt05_item_type_nm AS flt10_tr_item_type_nm , b.apr01_reg_date AS flt10_appr_reg_date , b.apr01_status_cd AS flt10_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS flt10_appr_status_nm , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ') ' || flt03_account_nm AS flt10_account_info , f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS flt10_account_relate_nm , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ')' AS flt10_account_no , flt03_family_relate_cd AS flt10_account_relate_cd , COALESCE(COALESCE(flt05_tr.flt05_target_yn, flt05.flt05_target_yn), 'false') AS flt10_check_target_yn , COALESCE(COALESCE(flt05_tr.flt05_stk_price_yn, flt05.flt05_stk_price_yn)::varchar, 'false') AS flt10_stk_price_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt10_status_cd,'00') = '00' THEN '미신고' WHEN COALESCE(flt10_status_cd,'00') = '10' THEN '미승인' ELSE f_cdnm('FloorTrStatusCode', flt10_status_cd, flt10_company_id, f_today()) END AS flt10_status_nm , flt10_tr_amt AS flt10_bef_tr_amt , CASE WHEN flt01_appr_over_rate < (flt10_tr_amt - flt10_expect_tr_amt) / f_nvl(flt10_expect_tr_amt,1) * 100 THEN '사전승인금액초과' ELSE null END AS over_amt_msg , CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt01_appr_qty_over_rate,0) != 0 AND flt01_appr_qty_over_rate < (flt10_tr_qty - flt10_expect_tr_qty) / f_nvl(flt10_expect_tr_qty,1) * 100 THEN '사전승인수량초과' ELSE null END AS over_qty_msg , CASE WHEN flt10_expect_tr_date < flt10_tr_date THEN '유효기간초과' ELSE null END AS over_period_msg FROM flt10_tr INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON flt10_appr_id = b.apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( flt10_person_id = emp03_person_id AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') AND emp03_trans_date = (SELECT max(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp03_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= CAST(#{closeDate} AS date))) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05 ON ( flt05.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_expect_tr_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05_tr ON ( flt05_tr.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_tr.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_tr.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_tr_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_tr_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{closeDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) flt01 ON flt01_company_id = flt10_company_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( WHERE flt10_tr_id = #{trId} ) a
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt10_tr (flt10_tr_id, flt10_company_id, flt10_person_id, flt10_appr_yn, flt10_account_id, flt10_tr_type, flt10_tr_date, flt10_tr_item_type, flt10_tr_item_nm, flt10_tr_item_cd, flt10_tr_qty, flt10_tr_amt, flt10_tr_note) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, 'false', #{req.accountId}, #{req.trType}, CAST(#{req.trDate} AS date), #{req.trItemType}, #{req.trItemName}, #{req.trItemCode}, #{req.trQty}, #{req.trAmt}, #{req.trNote})
mapper.update: UPDATE flt10_tr SET flt10_tr_date = null , flt10_tr_item_cd = null , flt10_tr_item_nm = null , flt10_tr_item_type = null , flt10_tr_qty = null , flt10_tr_amt = null WHERE flt10_tr_id = #{trId} AND flt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt10_person_id = #{personId} AND flt10_expect_tr_amt IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(f_get_biz_date(#{companyId}, CAST(#{baseDate} AS date), '-0'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT COALESCE(flt01_invest_amt_over_check_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS invest_amt_over_check_yn , COALESCE(flt02_year_invest_limit,0) AS year_invest_limit , f_get_floorTrCheck('1', flt02_company_id, flt02_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false) AS year_invest_amt , COALESCE(flt01_total_invest_amt ,0) AS total_invest_limit , f_get_floorTrCheck('2', flt02_company_id, flt02_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false) AS total_invest_amt FROM flt02_emp INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = flt02_company_id AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON TRUE WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT flt14_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , flt14_appr_id AS appr_id , TO_CHAR(apr01_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_reg_date , apr01_title AS appr_title , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name FROM flt14_relate_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = flt14_person_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt14_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND flt14_person_id = #{personId} AND flt14_std_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt14_relate_appr_id

SELECT sys12_working_yn FROM sys12_calendar INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys12_company_id WHERE sys12_company_id != 0 AND sys12_day = CAST(#{stdDate} AS timestamp) AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys01_company_id LIMIT 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(f_get_biz_date( #{companyId} , CASE WHEN #{checkCycle} = '1' THEN f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), '1') WHEN #{checkCycle} = '2' THEN f_get_last_day((CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) + interval '-1month')::date) ELSE null END , '-0'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flt03_account WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_person_id = #{personId} AND flt03_setup_date < CAST(#{preStdDate} AS date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM flt06_account_close INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt06_appr_id WHERE flt06_account_id = flt03_account_id AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('99','40') )

SELECT count(*) FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{personId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') AND apr01_class_tree_id IN ( SELECT dcr30_class_tree_id FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = apr01_company_id AND dcr30_link_cd = 'A09' ) /* (A09:자기매매 실거래 보고) */ AND apr01_effect_date BETWEEN CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND f_get_last_day(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))

SELECT count(*) FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{personId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') AND apr01_class_tree_id IN ( SELECT dcr30_class_tree_id FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = apr01_company_id AND dcr30_link_cd = 'A09' ) /* (A09:자기매매 실거래 보고) */ AND apr01_effect_date > f_get_biz_date(#{companyId}, f_get_last_day(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)), '-0')
SELECT f_insert_floorTrBook(#{companyId}, #{personId}, '%', '%', '%', '%', CAST(#{startDate} AS date))

SELECT COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn::varchar, 'false') = 'true' FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt05_item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCode} AND flt05_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt05_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt10_tr (flt10_tr_id, flt10_company_id, flt10_person_id, flt10_appr_yn, flt10_account_id, flt10_tr_date, flt10_tr_type, flt10_tr_item_type, flt10_tr_item_nm, flt10_tr_item_cd, flt10_tr_qty, flt10_tr_amt) VALUES (f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, 'false', #{accountId}, #{trDate}, #{trType}, #{trItemType}, #{trItemName}, #{trItemCode}, #{trQty}, #{trAmt})
mapper.select: SELECT flt02_check_cycle AS check_cycle , TO_CHAR(COALESCE(flt01_rpt_start_date, '1900-01-01'::date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rpt_start_date , TO_CHAR(emp01_hire_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hire_date , COALESCE(flt01_no_account_skip_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS no_account_skip_yn FROM flt02_emp INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = flt02_person_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND flt01_rpt_start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) flt01 ON TRUE WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
